title: Interview Playbook
description: COMPANY-level interview documents — apply to every job: interviewing style, culture, topics not to ask, the default scoring rubric.
noPlaybooksHint: Upload interview documents (PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD) or a scoring rubric (.xlsx) so the AI interviews and scores per company configuration.
uploadHint: Applies to EVERY job. PDF / DOCX / TXT / MD — will be chunked + embedded into RAG.
rubricHint: A scoring rubric is an Excel sheet following the template: criterion key, display name, weight (%) and scoring standard. Weights must sum to exactly 100 — otherwise the file is rejected.
jobScopedHint: Job and round playbooks are added by the primary Hiring Manager right on the job page (the HR Leader can add/delete them there too). This page shows them for an overview only.
